mem.9:
Sam and Evan — conversation through 27 August 2023

**18 May 2023**
- Evan returned from a family hiking trip in the Rockies, loved the views, and shared a lake/mountain photo. His old Prius broke down; he repaired and sold it, then got a new Prius.
- Sam loved hiking but hadn’t gone in years; recalled hiking with their dad at age 10 and shared a forest photo of a man and child. Sam was considering painting as a relaxing hobby, shared a paint-set photo, but hadn’t tried it. Evan had painted watercolors for years after a friend introduced him; shared a cactus/desert painting and said painting de-stresses him. He encouraged Sam to try hobbies. Sam also shared a sunset photo with feet on a car dashboard.

**20–24 May 2023**
- Evan took his family to Jasper via the Icefields Parkway; enjoyed glaciers and lakes and stayed in a cozy mountain/forest cabin. He called Jasper peaceful and shared a glacier photo (described as someone holding a book before a lake). Sam thought it looked breathtaking.
- Sam had a tough week; a disappointing weight measurement at a doctor’s check-up prompted thoughts about changing habits. Evan suggested enjoyable exercise and small food changes. They discussed painting as stress relief; Evan noted it doesn’t directly affect weight.

**6 June 2023**
- Evan described a frightening heart-palpitations episode the previous week that made him rethink his lifestyle; shared a medicine photo. Sam was trying to eat healthier and shared vegetables/milk, but still liked soda and candy. Evan was reducing processed food and sugary snacks, though ginger snaps were a weakness. He suggested flavored seltzer and high-cocoa dark chocolate; Sam agreed to try.
- Evan offered to teach Sam basic exercises and work out together; Sam was keen. Evan shared a man holding a dumbbell. Sam was in a terrible mood because all supermarket self-checkout machines were broken.

**27 July 2023**
- Sam said friends had mocked their weight the previous Friday; it hurt and motivated change. Evan apologized, reassured Sam, and offered support. Sam was becoming active and trying to cut soda/candy. Evan described his own past health struggles and recommended less sugar, more fruit/vegetables, seltzer, popcorn, or fruit. He shared “let it shine” cards as a reminder of his gym membership.
- Evan said he was reading *The Great Gatsby*, calling it a gripping new mystery novel; shared images described as fruit bowls/alcohol and a book with a green apple. He also shared a mountain-hiker image and encouraged exercise alongside diet. Sam planned to start regular gym exercise the next day.

**7 August 2023**
- Evan had visited Canada the previous week and met an “awesome Canadian woman,” a new romantic interest/partner. He said she made him feel alive, like a movie; shared a couple walking hand-in-hand in snow. Sam congratulated him and mentioned his health issues; Evan said she was fun and energizing.
- Evan said family and kids brought joy through health struggles; shared a woman and child on a swing. His health journey had lasted two years, with ups and downs. A fitness watch helped him track progress and stay motivated; Sam considered ordering one. Evan also cited adventures/hikes and caring for a bonsai (symbolizing strength/resilience) as motivation. They agreed small consistent actions build resilience. Evan signed off “Catch ya later!”

**13 August 2023**
- Evan returned from Canada with his new significant other; they hiked and biked. Shared a tent in a grassy field.
- Sam said challenges were affecting their health and Evan’s support helped them stay positive; shared a notepad quote: “Don't fear it, just take the first step. It's been helping me move forward to healthier habits!” Evan encouraged celebrating small wins; Sam said this helped with setbacks.
- Evan often loses his keys and had searched for half an hour. Sam described a vivid dream of soaring over skyscrapers and asked what it meant; Evan suggested a dream-interpretation book. Sam said the health journey felt endless but rewarding.

**15 August 2023**
- Evan’s son hurt his ankle in a soccer accident the previous Saturday. Evan cared for him and took him to the doctor; shared a cast/foot photo. The injury was improving but still sore and not serious.
- Sam had a tough week and a doctor’s appointment that felt like a wake-up call. Sam was taking a cooking class to learn healthier meals and made grilled salmon with vegetables; shared a photo and offered recipes. Evan asked for vegetable recipes; Sam offered roasted vegetables. Both encouraged one another; Sam felt concerned but motivated, taking things step by step.

**19 August 2023**
- Sam announced starting a diet and healthier lifestyle; it was tough but they were determined. Shared spinach, avocado, and strawberry bowl. Sam noticed more energy and less sluggishness after eating.
- Sam shared a grilled chicken-and-vegetable stir-fry recipe with homemade sauce and offered the recipe. Evan wanted to try it; Sam sent a recipe-card photo described as having a vase-of-flowers drawing.
- Evan had recently started painting classes, seeking like-minded people and a chance to improve/show his work. A friend’s painting had inspired him to start years earlier. The class teaches watercolors, observing nature, and painting what they see; painting helps him find peace and express himself. Shared a forest painting, painting supplies, watercolors, a bright sunset-over-ocean landscape, and a flowering tree image.
- Evan said nature/landscape painting brings peace and recalled road trips in his “trusty car”; shared a truck in a forest. He had driven somewhere fun the previous month, with amazing views, and skied in Banff. He enjoyed skiing, snowboarding, and ice skating and hoped to return next year; shared ski photos. Sam wanted to try skiing but worried their body couldn’t handle it. Evan hoped Sam could join him someday; Sam said maybe, thanked him for understanding, and noted it was hard for them.

**27 August 2023**
- Sam said they started a new diet and exercise routine on Monday, 21 August, and felt great; asked what changes Evan had made. Evan said he twisted his knee on Friday, 25 August, and it was very painful, interrupting his usual fitness routine; staying active is very important to him. Sam sympathized and offered help. Evan said life throws curveballs and mentioned the book he’d discussed, saying it got better with every page and he couldn’t put it down. Sam suggested low-impact exercise or physical therapy and said Evan had made them interested in the book. Evan said PT was planned, he hoped for an appointment soon, and meanwhile he was taking it easy and swimming. Sam encouraged swimming as low-impact and refreshing.
- Evan shared a photo from a road trip the previous month: car parked beside a lake with mountains behind it. He said he went to the Rocky Mountains, found the scenery stunning and nature calming/refreshing, and asked if Sam liked road trips and exploring nature. Sam hadn’t road-tripped in ages but loved nature; hiking was challenging, though they hoped getting healthier might make a trip and hike possible.
- Evan recommended hiking, saying it was calming and fun, and suggested they hike together sometime; shared a lake/mountain photo. Sam asked which lake and wanted local trails. Evan shared another lake/mountain photo and recommended it as gorgeous, with many nearby trails. It was a two-hour drive from “here”; he said the views and peaceful atmosphere were worth it. Sam said a day trip was doable and planned to check it out. They said goodbye warmly. The lake was not named.

Sam loved hiking but hadn’t gone in years, recalling hikes with their dad at age 10, and considered painting to relax. Evan had painted watercolors for years and shared a cactus/desert painting.

24 May–June: Sam felt discouraged after a hard week and weigh-in. Evan suggested enjoyable exercise and small food changes; Sam planned to paint without pressure. Evan’s family visited Jasper, drove the Icefields Parkway, saw glaciers and lakes, and stayed in a peaceful cabin. On 6 June Evan described frightening heart palpitations and avoiding processed food and sugary snacks, though he liked ginger snaps. Sam liked soda and candy; Evan suggested flavored seltzer and dark chocolate, and Sam would try seltzer. Evan offered workout lessons; Sam was keen. Sam complained about broken supermarket self-checkouts.

Evan suggested seltzer, popcorn or fruit. He recommended *The Great Gatsby*, not a mystery. Sam might read it, adopted “progress, not perfection,” and planned gym visits.
